source.note: The later documentation-only handoff commit does not change this executable.

artifact.installed_location: Exact operator-local executable path supplied in the authorized completion Queue message; query api version to verify.

client_steps: Resolve the exact tracked turn and current catalog/runtime generations; never target by display name.
Call api checkpoints with cursor null initially.

Consume whole text snapshots, deduplicate by event_id and persist the returned cursor after consumption. Pages stop at 50 events or 768 KiB total wire bytes; has_more remains true when bytes defer events. Sequence is first-observation order.
Continue reads while tracking the same turn. has_more concerns journal events; scan_pending concerns native pages.
On stale turn/runtime or failure preserve previous evidence; never borrow a newer turn or replay input. On cursor gap explicitly reset with null and surface history_gap.
Keep receipt polling separate. A checkpoint is not proof of Steer consumption, causation, delivery, completion or correlated reply.
Negotiate capabilities and compatible additive API revisions; update the explicit executable pin using the verified artifact hash.

limits.observation: Native public snapshot polling; transient revisions between polls may be missed. Failed/interrupted/completed latest turns are distinguishable. Unknown phases are omitted.
limits.restart: Journal reload retains IDs/order; a changed provider runtime needs fresh explicit target resolution, not cursor carryover.
limits.response_bytes_include: Entire compact UTF-8 JSON success envelope and trailing newline, after JSON escaping
limits.byte_pagination: Whole events only; cursor advances to last returned event. Drain unread journal events before scanning more native items; exact turn/runtime checks remain active. Replay never renews event/page observation age.

cases: Synthetic HERDR/tmux exact tracked active turn exposes checkpoint then continues
Repeated reads/journal reopen deduplicate and preserve stable IDs/order
Public projection excludes reasoning, tool output, user input and unknown phases
Stale turn, wrong item turn, disconnected provider and runtime mismatch refuse
Failed native turn is reported separately from assistant text
Bounded pagination, cursor gaps, revision ceiling and invalid-page refusal

Fifty near-64-KiB public items, multibyte UTF-8 and maximum JSON control-character escaping: every full envelope plus newline <=768 KiB, no lost/duplicate events, deterministic replay and cursor progress
Oversized public text rejected; replay does not advance native scan or evict unread backlog

native_source_evidence.finding: Summary projection excludes commentary/partial_answer; turn-filtered thread/items/list exposes public assistant items independently.
